description: AIclicks connects your AI assistant to your brand's AI search data. See how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Copilot and Grok mention your brand, and compare that to your competitors. Pull citations, mentions, share of voice, and visibility trends without opening a dashboard. Built for teams who want to know where they stand in AI search and fix visibility gaps fast.

defaultPrompt: How visible is my brand in AI search right now, and how has that changed this month?
Which competitors are winning share of voice in AI answers about my industry?
Which of my pages do ChatGPT and Google AI Mode cite the most?
